### GET /api/v1/clinical-privileges/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `clinical_privileges_list` |
| Method and path | `GET /api/v1/clinical-privileges/` |
| Business purpose | List (clinical privileges). What the hospital lets people perform (HIMS-STAFF-016). The hospital writes the list. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-STAFF-016](../../../requirements/staff-and-rota.md#hims-staff-016) |
| Actor / permission required | `staff.view` (View the staff directory, qualifications and credentials (a facility or department grant shows only the staff posted there)). System roles holding it: Organization administrator, Facility (branch) administrator, HR / credentialing officer, Head of department (HOD). Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Facility or department: a grant at one facility or department is enough; rows outside it stay hidden (404) |
| Request schema | No body; query: `include_inactive` |
| Response schema | 200 list of `ClinicalPrivilege` |
| Validation rules | Query values outside the allowed ones are refused (400) or ignored |
| Allowed current states | Any |
| Resulting state | Unchanged (read only) |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not applicable (read only) |
| Concurrency control | None needed (read only) |
| Database transaction | Read only |
| Audit event | None of its own (reads of configuration are not audited; a refusal records `access.denied`) |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request |
| Expected error codes | 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`); pages of 25 (`page_size` up to 100) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |

|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `clinical_privileges_create` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/clinical-privileges/` |

| Requirements | [HIMS-STAFF-016](../../../requirements/staff-and-rota.md#hims-staff-016) |
| Actor / permission required | `catalogs.manage` (Add and change job titles, specialties and qualification types). System roles holding it: Organization administrator, HR / credentialing officer. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |

| Request schema | `ClinicalPrivilegeCreateRequest`: `name` (required, ≤ 255 characters), `description` (≤ 1000 characters) |
| Response schema | 201 `ClinicalPrivilege` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | `Idempotency-Key` header (optional; operation `catalogs.clinical_privileges.create`): the same key with the same body replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); with a different body 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; kept 48 hours |
| Concurrency control | No version check (adds a new record or is a one-off action); unique rules in the database refuse duplicates |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | None of its own (reads of configuration are not audited; a refusal records `access.denied`) |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request; the client may retry a lost answer with the same Idempotency-Key |
| Expected error codes | 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, 400 `INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 409 `CONFLICT`, 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/staff/tests/test_clinical_privileges.py::test_hims_ships_no_privileges_the_hospital_writes_the_list`, `apps/staff/tests/test_clinical_privileges.py::test_who_may_see_and_give` |
